kind: exact retained reusable-core extraction evidence; no new execution

hash_bound_omissions.reason: Full Cargo metadata graph; concise resolution-check.json and lock/input bindings are copied.

compression: Large stdout logs only: deterministic gzip with an empty filename and mtime=0. Decompression recovers raw_path exactly; raw_sha256 and uncompressed_bytes match retained supervisor identities.
selection: Both Rust toolchains: planner default checks and final optional-GPU/probe checks, resolver receipts, source/binary identities, all logs, one glyph CPU run, all four three-adapter host runs, preservation/source-ready and completed-run reviews.
exclusions: Existing source/fixture/font/reference populations (bound by the copied source manifest and host records)
attribution: Copied records retain their original scope and phase. GPU compared bytes, CPU differential/reference bytes and whole-frame fallback bytes remain separate in host reports and the completed-run audit. This index reports byte identities and makes no new performance, security or compatibility claim.
